Behind the Hawthorn

You flinch into a scatter of leaves and emerge a few paces from where the blow found you.

Rules

Action: Reaction · Attribute: None — no roll

Target / range / shape: Self, after a visible attack resolves against you.

Vanish into a swirl of leaves and reappear in a visible free square within 2 squares. No opaque barrier may separate the squares. This teleport does not provoke.

Duration: Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 3 · DP: 4 · Requirements to learn: Mind 2

Type: Magic

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: behind-the-hawthorn
